about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Designer, developer, and creative technologist building the future of digital experiences.
bioparagraphs: I'm a full-stack developer and designer based in the Netherlands, specializing in creating immersive web experiences that push the boundaries of what's possible in the browser.

With a background in computer science and a passion for creative technology, I bridge the gap between design and development. From 3D interactions to seamless animations, I build digital products that users love.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or sharing knowledge with the developer community.

experience.subtitle: A track record of building great products with amazing teams.

jobs.description: Leading the frontend team in building a next-generation SaaS platform using React, Next.js, and WebGL.
Developed award-winning immersive web experiences for global brands. Specialized in GSAP and Three.js animations.
Built the MVP from scratch using the MERN stack. Handled everything from database design to UI implementation.
